content.text: Golf buggy hire in the Algarve costs between **€40 and €55** for 18 holes at the courses that publish a price, and a few courses include a buggy in the green fee. Many clubs don't publish a hire price at all, and the rules on who can drive differ from one course to the next.

We checked each course's own price list, rules and online booking system, and this guide only includes what those sources state. Where a club doesn't publish something, we say so, and a course missing from a list here may simply not publish that information. **Last checked: November 2026.**
Algarve golf buggy prices by course
These are the current hire prices published by the clubs themselves. Most lists don't say whether the price is per buggy or per person, so it's worth asking when you book.

content.text: [Pestana](/courses/gramacho) also lists a twilight buggy at €40 for its courses. [Boavista](/courses/boavista)'s tariff shows a single €45 price without saying whether it covers 18 or 9 holes.
[Penina](/courses/penina-championship)'s last published list showed €55 for 18 holes and €35 for 9, but that list expired in October 2025, so contact the course for the current price.
Algarve golf courses where a buggy is included
At these courses, the green fee already covers a buggy, which is worth remembering when you compare prices with other courses.
**[Ombria](/courses/ombria)**: the club's rules say green fees always include a buggy on a shared basis, subject to availability. It may charge for a second buggy if you don't want to share.
**[Monte Rei](/courses/monte-rei)**: the club's online booking lists a buggy as part of its standard and twilight green fees.

**Amendoeira ([Faldo](/courses/amendoeira-faldo) and [O'Connor](/courses/amendoeira-oconnor))**: the online green fees are marked "Buggy included, if available". That wording means you shouldn't assume one is guaranteed, particularly if a buggy is essential for you.

[Vale do Lobo](/courses/vale-do-lobo-royal) includes a shared buggy on its Sunset green fee for full-paying adults, though not on its standard rate. Quinta do Lago states the opposite for its standard online rates: the buggy is not included.
Courses with buggies but no published hire price
You can get a buggy at these courses, but we couldn't find a current hire price from the club. Contact the course for the price before you travel:

[Quinta do Lago South](/courses/quinta-do-lago-south), [North](/courses/quinta-do-lago-north) and [Laranjal](/courses/quinta-do-lago-laranjal); [Vale do Lobo Royal](/courses/vale-do-lobo-royal) and [Ocean](/courses/vale-do-lobo-ocean); the four Vilamoura courses ([Old Course](/courses/vilamoura-old-course), [Millennium](/courses/vilamoura-millennium), [Pinhal](/courses/vilamoura-pinhal) and [Laguna](/courses/vilamoura-laguna)); [Palmares](/courses/palmares); [Espiche](/courses/espiche); [Quinta da Ria](/courses/quinta-da-ria), [Quinta de Cima](/courses/quinta-de-cima) and [Quinta do Vale](/courses/quinta-do-vale); [Morgado](/courses/morgado) and [Alamos](/courses/alamos); and [Pestana Ferragudo](/courses/pestana-ferragudo).
For [Pinheiros Altos](/courses/pinheiros-altos), we couldn't find current buggy details from an official source, so contact the course directly.
Algarve courses that may not have buggies
[Vale de Milho](/courses/vale-de-milho), a short 9-hole course, says plainly that it doesn't have buggies to hire but does offer trolleys.

The price lists at [Pine Cliffs](/courses/pine-cliffs) and [Balaia](/courses/balaia) include trolleys but no buggies. Neither club says outright that it has none, so contact the course if you need one.
Golf buggy rules: age limits and where you can drive
If a junior in your group wants to drive, check first, as the minimum age isn't the same everywhere.

content.text: The **90-degree rule** means you stay on the path until you're level with your ball, then turn straight across the fairway to reach it and return the same way.
We didn't find a club that publishes a driving licence requirement. If that matters to you or your group, ask when you book.

Weather can also change your plans. Vilamoura's course manager can stop buggies being used when necessary to protect the course, and Ombria and Penina state similar restrictions, so a buggy isn't guaranteed after heavy rain, even if you've paid for a round.
How to pay less for a buggy
The simplest saving is a rate that bundles the green fee with a shared buggy. These are the offers published at the time of writing:
**Quinta do Vale**: until 30 November 2026, €130 for one player with a buggy or €225 for two sharing, which works out at €112.50 each.
**Quinta da Ria and Quinta de Cima**: in December 2026, €120 for one player with a buggy or €220 for two sharing. In January 2027, it's €125 or €230.
**Quinta do Lago North and Laranjal**: from 1 December to 31 January, €170 per person for two players sharing a buggy.

**Vilamoura Laguna**: a free shared buggy on new bookings made by 31 December 2026, for play from 19 October 2026 to 31 December 2027. It isn't valid from 1 April to 31 May or from 16 September to 18 October 2027.
[Palmares](/courses/palmares) and [Espiche](/courses/espiche) also sell online rates that include a buggy, with prices that vary by date. Compare the two options before adding a buggy on arrival.
Is a golf buggy worth it in the Algarve?

It depends on the course, the season and how far you like to walk. A buggy makes the most sense on hilly courses and in the summer heat, and for anyone who finds a full 18 holes on foot too tiring. [Santo António](/courses/santo-antonio) is one example: the club itself lists a buggy as recommended, and adds that its buggies don't have GPS.

If you do want one, reserve it when you book your tee time rather than leaving it until you arrive, because several clubs describe buggies as subject to availability. If you'd rather stay on foot, see our guide to [Algarve golf courses you can walk](/guide/algarve-golf-courses-you-can-walk).

**Booking your rounds?** Our guide to [how to book tee times in the Algarve](/guide/how-to-book-tee-times-in-the-algarve) shows how each course takes bookings, when to book and the cancellation rules to check.

**Travelling as a group?** Our guide to [Algarve golf trips for groups and golf societies](/guide/algarve-golf-trips-for-groups-and-golf-societies) covers golf villas and apartments, booking tee times together, buggies and minivans.
